title: Saudi Arabian Oven Roasted Lamb Kebabs
description: A classic Saudi dish featuring tender lamb kebabs roasted to perfection in the oven. This recipe is perfect for a special occasion or a hearty family dinner.
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together garlic, paprika, cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and mix until they are evenly coated with the spice mixture.
Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Brush the skewers with olive oil and season with salt and black pepper.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Roast in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the lamb is cooked to your liking.
Remove the skewers from the oven and let them rest for 5 minutes before serving.
